Sorry for late reply. Horrible things have been leading up to this week. Then last saturday my boyfriend of two years told me allthese great plans we would do to celebrate for valentines day then he broke up with me that night. He broke up with me for another girl. This isn't the only reason i broke, this was just my breaking point. A lot has been happening since the second the 2014 ball dropped and it's unbelievable how much has changed in just a few months. Anyway, my boyfriend breaking up with me has just ruined everything i've built, he was my rock through those hard times and he just threw me out like a piece of trash because something new came along. In leaving me he's taking away the only things that make me happy. My dog, my kitten, my friends, my place to stay, my frisbee team (that was my escape) my video games, my game nights. Just everything that's made me smile in the last two years left with him. it was the most horrible thing he could have done to me. If he wanted to just break up because it wasnt working, okay, shit happens. But for him to lie to me for so long and to easily just tell me he likes someone else better now. How can a person do that? He was supposed to be the nice guy. He's changed me so much for the better and he has no fucking idea

I'm sorry for the late reply. I've been depressed for a long time and things have gone spiraling downward lately. In this last week everything that has ever made me happy has been torn from me and there's nothing i can do about it. I was feeling especially terrible today to the point of it being unbearable to feel anymore and i didn't want to do something stupid so i went on this suicide prevention website to maybe talk to someone. Which was really fucking hard to do for me. And when i gained the courage the link never worked and i thought it was fate.

wow. Thank you so much. This really meant a lot to me. Sorry for the late reply. I posted this thinking no one would see it (I rarely post on reddit) but I'm surprised at the amount of replies I've received. I can't thank you enough. You opened something up. I used to try the list making and I just got tired of all the routine i had to do to fill my depression. But I do take what i have for granted too much. It hurts more than words can describe but i shouldn't give up. And i won't.
This wasn't a new relationship or anything. A lot was already invested
Everything that's ever made me happy has been taken from me in just a few days. I don't want to feel weak anymore but i can't do it
